case_name: Cantilever beam modal extraction, 1m x 50mm x 50mm SA-516 Gr.70 steel, structured C3D20 40x2x2 hex
status_reason: Tier 1 engineering candidate. The CalculiX *FREQUENCY modal eigenfrequency on the structured 40x2x2 C3D20 hex mesh agrees with the Euler-Bernoulli closed-form analytical cantilever solution to within engineering tolerance (mode 1 0.14%, mode 3 0.98%, mode 8 axial 0.07% per Phase 12 A smoke validation 2026-05-16). Signed validation, benchmark agreement, and Tier 2 promotion are explicitly deferred.
